# `gh issue artifact download` ## Table of Contents ### `help` | Category | Scenario | |---|---| | Help | [`download`](#user-content-help-download) | ### `gh issue artifact download` | Category | Scenario | |---|---| | Downloading | [All artifacts](#user-content-download-all) | | Downloading | [Selected artifacts](#user-content-download-selected) | | Downloading | [By URL](#user-content-download-by-url) | | Downloading | [Unusual names](#user-content-download-unusual-names) | | Downloading | [With `--dir`](#user-content-download-into-dir) | | Existing files | [A file already exists](#user-content-download-existing-file) | | Existing files | [With `--skip-existing`](#user-content-download-skip-existing) | | Existing files | [With `--clobber`](#user-content-download-clobber) | | Existing files | [Symlinked target](#user-content-download-symlink-target) | | Single artifact | [With `--output `](#user-content-download-output-file) | | Single artifact | [With `--output -`](#user-content-download-output-stdout) | | Single artifact | [With `--version`](#user-content-download-version) | | Errors | [Error: `--output` with several artifacts](#user-content-download-error-output-needs-one) | | Errors | [Error: `--version` without one artifact](#user-content-download-error-version-needs-one) | | Errors | [Error: `--clobber` with `--skip-existing`](#user-content-download-error-clobber-and-skip) | | Errors | [Error: `--dir` with `--output`](#user-content-download-error-dir-and-output) | | Errors | [Error: no artifacts](#user-content-download-error-no-artifacts) | | Scripting | [Piped output](#user-content-download-piped) | | Scripting | [Piped output with existing files](#user-content-download-piped-existing) | --- ## `help`
What is changing - **Help**: Help for `gh issue artifact download`
#### `download` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download --help ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4e91a1cd-3c92-4c10-b8ad-b8310642883b)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf 'Download issue artifacts to files. Without artifact numbers, every artifact on the issue is downloaded. Artifacts can also be named by their URLs, which must all be on one issue. `` is an issue number or URL. Each file is named `-`. Documents end in `.md`, and links are saved as `.url` Internet Shortcut files. If a file already exists, that artifact fails unless you use `--clobber` to overwrite it or `--skip-existing` to skip it. Use `--output` to choose the path for a single artifact, or `--output -` to print its content. Use `--version` with a single artifact to download an earlier version from its edit history. \033[0;1;39mUSAGE\033[0m gh issue artifact download { [...] | ...} [flags] \033[0;1;39mFLAGS\033[0m --clobber Overwrite existing files of the same name -D, --dir directory The directory to download files into (default ".") -O, --output file The file to write a single artifact to (use "-" to write to standard output) --skip-existing Skip downloading when files of the same name exist --version number Download the version with this number from the edit history \033[0;1;39mINHERITED FLAGS\033[0m --help Show help for command -R, --repo [HOST/]OWNER/REPO Select another repository using the [HOST/]OWNER/REPO format \033[0;1;39mEXAMPLES\033[0m # Download every artifact on issue 142 $ gh issue artifact download 142 # Download two artifacts into a folder $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 5 --dir notes # Print one artifact'\''s content $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 --output - # Download an earlier version of one artifact $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 --version 5 \033[0;1;39mLEARN MORE\033[0m Use `gh --help` for more information about a command. Read the manual at https://cli.github.com/manual Learn about exit codes using `gh help exit-codes` Learn about accessibility experiences using `gh help accessibility` ' > help-download.ans freeze help-download.ans --output help-download.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1560 ```
--- ## `gh issue artifact download`
What is changing - **Downloading**: Download every artifact on the issue into the current directory - **Downloading**: Download only the given artifact numbers - **Downloading**: Artifact URLs can replace the issue and numbers - **Downloading**: Spaces become `-`, a name that already ends in `.md` isn't given a second one, and the number prefix keeps Windows device names like CON safe - **Downloading**: Download into another directory with `--dir` - **Existing files**: Existing files are not overwritten; the others are still written, and the command exits 1 - **Existing files**: `--skip-existing` leaves existing files alone and is not a failure - **Existing files**: `--clobber` overwrites existing files - **Existing files**: gh never writes through a symlink, even with `--clobber` - **Single artifact**: `--output` writes one artifact to a chosen path - **Single artifact**: `--output -` writes only the body to standard output, with no status line - **Single artifact**: `--version` writes an earlier version, named by the usual rule from that version's name - **Errors**: `--output` needs exactly one artifact number - **Errors**: `--version` needs exactly one artifact number - **Errors**: `--clobber` and `--skip-existing` are mutually exclusive - **Errors**: `--dir` and `--output` are mutually exclusive - **Errors**: An issue with no artifacts fails, like the other download commands - **Scripting**: When piped, each artifact gets a `\t\t\t\t` line on stdout, with an empty source - **Scripting**: When piped, skipped and failed files are lines on stdout too, and any failure exits 1
#### All artifacts *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41ca54c0-9995-4e27-bf20-2bd002214a3e)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-all.ans freeze download-all.ans --output download-all.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - 2-OAuth-callback-plan.md and 5-Barista-feedback-notes.md contain exactly their artifacts' bodies - 3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url contains "[InternetShortcut]" and "URL=https://github.com/monalisa/monas-cafe/wiki/OAuth-runbook" with CRLF line endings
--- #### Selected artifacts *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 5 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/438acf3a-39fd-43ee-abce-2ea3959589e2)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-selected.ans freeze download-selected.ans --output download-selected.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### By URL *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download https://github.com/monalisa/monas-cafe/issues/142/artifacts/2 https://github.com/monalisa/monas-cafe/issues/142/artifacts/5 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ffa8103f-2ef0-4062-9b0b-85a7d12cd4bf)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-by-url.ans freeze download-by-url.ans --output download-by-url.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### Unusual names *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 145 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41c2f691-fc10-46af-9f32-6411fbaa2a35)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:1-My-implementation-plan.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:2-README.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:3-CON.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:4-日本語メモ.md}} ' > download-unusual-names.ans freeze download-unusual-names.ans --output download-unusual-names.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - All four files are written directly in the current directory, and nothing is written elsewhere
--- #### With `--dir` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --dir artifacts ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/56e4eee6-dcd5-4c72-9dad-ceff19bd156d)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:artifacts/2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:artifacts/3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:artifacts/5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-into-dir.ans freeze download-into-dir.ans --output download-into-dir.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - The artifacts directory is created if it does not exist
--- #### A file already exists *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62e3716d-cde7-4437-bfa4-ecd5c88699db)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;31mX\033[0m Failed to write {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}}: already exists (use --clobber to overwrite or --skip-existing to skip) \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-existing-file.ans freeze download-existing-file.ans --output download-existing-file.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - The existing 2-OAuth-callback-plan.md is unchanged
--- #### With `--skip-existing` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --skip-existing ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75add997-c87a-46f1-b9cd-cc371f68c1d4)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[38;5;242m-\033[0m Skipped {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}}: already exists \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-skip-existing.ans freeze download-skip-existing.ans --output download-skip-existing.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### With `--clobber` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --clobber ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c338a493-bc09-4d01-b4c9-20f9303501c5)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-clobber.ans freeze download-clobber.ans --output download-clobber.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - 2-OAuth-callback-plan.md now holds the artifact's current body
--- #### Symlinked target *Input:* ```bash $ printf 'keep\n' > other.md && ln -s other.md 2-OAuth-callback-plan.md ``` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --clobber ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/619c2b6d-263b-4e73-ab77-ea9e9eaf2dcd)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;31mX\033[0m Failed to write {{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}}: is a symlink \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}} \033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}} ' > download-symlink-target.ans freeze download-symlink-target.ans --output download-symlink-target.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - The symlink and other.md are unchanged
--- #### With `--output ` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 --output callback-plan.md ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/af451d44-524f-4ca0-8714-90fc44cde547)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:callback-plan.md}} ' > download-output-file.ans freeze download-output-file.ans --output download-output-file.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - callback-plan.md contains exactly artifact 2's body
--- #### With `--output -` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 --output - ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c4929b9-11cf-42ba-af2b-dfaa97bc4fc8)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '# {{heading:OAuth callback plan}} {{body_text:1. Register the callback URL.}} {{body_text:2. Wire up `order-history` sync.}} ' > download-output-stdout.ans freeze download-output-stdout.ans --output download-output-stdout.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### With `--version` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 --version 5 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e330c39-0241-4faa-8a1a-9e3976ad10f9)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '\033[0;32m✓\033[0m {{file_name:2-OAuth-plan.md}} ' > download-version.ans freeze download-version.ans --output download-version.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - 2-OAuth-plan.md contains exactly the body of version 5 of artifact 2
--- #### Error: `--output` with several artifacts *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 5 --output callback-plan.md ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de0e2b17-34c7-47c7-b9c2-e5bb82ec5edc)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '--output requires exactly one artifact number ' > download-error-output-needs-one.ans freeze download-error-output-needs-one.ans --output download-error-output-needs-one.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### Error: `--version` without one artifact *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --version 5 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de589662-08b0-4da2-8960-0e111212b86d)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf '--version requires exactly one artifact number ' > download-error-version-needs-one.ans freeze download-error-version-needs-one.ans --output download-error-version-needs-one.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### Error: `--clobber` with `--skip-existing` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --clobber --skip-existing ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0789e01f-2819-417d-becf-9c1fc97dbb99)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf 'specify only one of `--clobber` or `--skip-existing` ' > download-error-clobber-and-skip.ans freeze download-error-clobber-and-skip.ans --output download-error-clobber-and-skip.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### Error: `--dir` with `--output` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 2 --dir notes --output callback-plan.md ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c480011c-2b90-4f35-9969-27cebc406123)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf 'specify only one of `--dir` or `--output` ' > download-error-dir-and-output.ans freeze download-error-dir-and-output.ans --output download-error-dir-and-output.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### Error: no artifacts *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 161 ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46b700b6-5a8d-48f9-b742-2b64add5ff2c)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf 'no artifacts to download from {{repo_ref:monalisa/monas-cafe#161}} ' > download-error-no-artifacts.ans freeze download-error-no-artifacts.ans --output download-error-no-artifacts.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - No files are written
--- #### Piped output *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 --clobber | cat ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ffb3827f-77a5-4484-ad90-19497b76bcc5)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf 'written\t{{number:2}}\t{{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}}\t\t written\t{{number:3}}\t{{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}}\t\t written\t{{number:5}}\t{{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}}\t\t ' > download-piped.ans freeze download-piped.ans --output download-piped.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
--- #### Piped output with existing files *Input:* ```bash $ set -o pipefail ``` *Input:* ```bash $ gh issue artifact download 142 | cat ``` *Output:* ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3046c9b8-1b1b-40c7-8677-4a83d0374b4e)
Source & reproduction ```bash printf 'failed\t{{number:2}}\t{{file_name:2-OAuth-callback-plan.md}}\t\talready exists (use --clobber to overwrite or --skip-existing to skip) written\t{{number:3}}\t{{file_name:3-Staging-OAuth-runbook.url}}\t\t written\t{{number:5}}\t{{file_name:5-Barista-feedback-notes.md}}\t\t ' > download-piped-existing.ans freeze download-piped-existing.ans --output download-piped-existing.png --language ansi --font.family 'JetBrains Mono,SF Mono,Menlo,monospace' --font.size 12 --line-height 1.4 --window --padding '20,40,20,20' --background '#2b3037' --margin 20 --shadow.blur 6 --border.radius 8 --width 1360 ```
Expected effects - The existing 2-OAuth-callback-plan.md is unchanged
